up: Retrieve all activity records from the activities table for the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL1614174, along with the corresponding compound structures. For each activity, output the compound's ChEMBL ID (molecule_dictionary.chembl_id), the compound's preferred name (molecule_dictionary.pref_name), the canonical SMILES (compound_structures.canonical_smiles), the standardized activity type (activities.standard_type), the standardized relation (activities.standard_relation), the standardized numeric value (activities.standard_value), the standardized units (activities.standard_units), and the pChemBL value (activities.pchembl_value). Include every activity row for that assay without aggregation, deduplication, or additional filters. Do not restrict to any specific relation type or value range; include all available data.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles, a.standard_type, a.standard_relation, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.pchembl_value FROM activities a JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1614174';
